retained.label: Booking and service facts
retained.reason: Kept for contract history, schedule history, and counterparty access. Party display values and owned files are redacted.

retained.label: Payments, refunds, and transfers
retained.reason: Kept for settlement, reconciliation, and financial audit. Amounts, statuses, provider ids, and stable user ids stay unchanged.

retained.label: Invoices and credit notes
retained.reason: Invoice numbers, credit-note numbers, artifact history, and files under the invoice root are retained evidence and are not deleted.

retained.label: Dispute and cancellation decisions
retained.reason: Financial outcomes, admin decisions, and statuses stay. Target-authored narrative and target-owned evidence files are redacted.

retained.label: Warranty decisions
retained.reason: Warranty status, deadlines, and resolution outcomes stay. Target-authored narrative and target-owned evidence files are redacted.

retained.label: Support history
retained.reason: Ticket, meeting, and reply rows stay without the target's content so support audit and counterparty context still resolve.

retained.label: Anonymization audit
retained.reason: A minimal record keeps the stable target id, admin id, action, time, outcome, and counts. It does not store the old name or email.

warnings: External provider records (for example Stripe, Brevo, and Odoo) are not changed by this endpoint.
Invoices and credit-note files are retained as financial evidence and are not deleted.
Counterparty-authored, admin-authored, and unknown-authorship free text inside retained records is preserved by policy and is not rewritten.

Legacy notifications and email logs without recorded actor provenance are only redacted when their entity relationship identifies a target-owned booking, conversation, project, or request. Records with no such provenance are retained and are not matched by name or email text.
